name: DUMBBELL UP-N-OVERS
introduce: Start by lying on the ground with your legs straight and your arms raised up with a dumbbell in your hands. \n\nRaise your upper body up and lower the dumbbell to one side of your body. Return to the starting position and then switch sides and do it again. Repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Please prepare a dumbbell and a mat.
Please always keep your abs tight.
Please use the strength of your abs to get up.
